items.claim: fit warning blames a box clipped inside an inner scroller
fit warning names `.lk-shell-body` itself when it has a classic scrollbar or a border
`Workspace` drops falsy children before matching `ids` to them
presented lab with `messages.origins` still posts its state to `'*'`
items.note: State now goes only to the listed origins; the `origins` doc, the `messages` prop doc, and the README say so.

items.claim: chord owner and framed check read the global `document`/`window`
items.note: framed half only. `isFramed` now reads the lab's own window. The chord half is not a defect: `ownerNow` reads the global `document`, and that is the document `LabKeys`' dispatcher listens on (`canvasRef: NO_ELEMENT`, so `attachInput` falls back to the global `document`). Focus and key events therefore come from the same place. In a popped-out window the lab's keys are not heard at all. That is a separate, larger gap: `LabKeys` mounts above `labBody`.

items.claim: `labkit:play` does not restart an ended run on a clock that can't seek
dark-mode starfield shows through a presented lab and lands in dark posters
items.note: Its test is in `presentation.browser.test.tsx`, which can't run here and is unrun.

items.claim: nebula ramp checked against weaselTheme instead of the lab's theme, so a ramp only the lab's theme declares throws
floating panels all pinned to one corner, so a second covers the first
items.note: They now stack in a column down the top-right corner, and the floating-strategy zone nothing ever registered in is removed. Its reproduction is `Workspace.floating.browser.test.tsx`, which can't run here and is unrun.
`TileGrip`'s draggable form had the same remount problem for its own contents, fixed in the same commit.

items.claim: `onReorder` returns `lk-panel-*` ids, and a child id with that prefix renders as an empty panel
one `useLabAmbient` caller unmounting removes every install of the same array
a lab presenting inline clears its host page's root background and color-scheme
items.note: The lab root now gets `lk-lab--framed` only inside a frame, and the rule keys on that class. jsdom covers the class; the existing browser test for the CSS is unrun here.

items.claim: `presentation.enter()` with no focused trial hides the chrome and presents nothing
items.note: `enter()` now does nothing until a trial is focused.

items.claim: SpanStrip's `font-size` and `line-height` repeated the same calc, and its 22px height fallback failed labkit's `check-design-tokens`
